description: Score one photo 0-100 as a professional headshot and list concrete issues and fixes (lighting, framing, face visibility, background, attire). Takes a public https URL to a JPEG/PNG/WebP image. Free: 5 audits per day per user. The photo is analysed and not stored.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 10 MB)

name: audit_headshot
title: Headshot audit
